action: The eagle crouches slightly, scoops up a golden trophy cup with both wings bent like arms, then stands up tall and raises it straight above its head, both wing tips gripping the trophy's two handles, wings bent up and symmetrical, holds the trophy high and steady with a big proud smile, then lowers it and settles. The trophy is a large, clearly visible golden cup with two handles, about as big as the eagle's head. The eagle's feathers, face and beak keep their normal colors the whole time with no glow, no aura and no light effects on the eagle; only the trophy shines. The branch and feet never move.
